svg.title: What is planned, and where it plugs in
svg.desc: Today's flow, adapters to the event log and workers to the DuckDB store to the API, with the matcher writing links, and the planned parts around it: inference reads READMEs and runbooks and sends proposed facts into ingest; search indexes the store for lookups through the API; automation acts on fact changes; a model matcher adds same-or-not judgements to the matcher. Also planned are an HTTP MCP endpoint, OIDC and GraphQL on the API, and attestation of provenance.

g.text: Attestation would sign the provenance facts already carry. Proposals stay apart from asserted facts.
